measures.what: With output shaft pointing up: measure body length and width below the mounting tabs, distance from tab underside to bottom of body, and total mounting-tab end-to-end span (mm).
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab)

measures.item: MG996R servo mounting tabs and body
measures.what: Please measure: (1) mounting-hole diameter (or slot width); (2) center-to-center distance between the two holes on the SAME end tab; (3) tab thickness; (4) tab underside to lowest point of servo body; (5) total tip-to-tip length across both tabs. Also confirm the 44.61 mm was the gap between the nearest edges of holes at opposite ends, not their centers. If practical, measure outside-edge to outside-edge of those same opposite holes too.
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo tab thickness: 2.28 mm
